source_extracts.claim: Standard mail forwarding lasts 12 months; extended forwarding purchasable for 6, 12, or 18 more months (18 max); when forwarding ends USPS returns mail to sender for 6 months with a new-address label
source_extracts.quote: Standard mail forwarding lasts 12 months. You can pay to extend mail forwarding for 6, 12, or 18 more months (18 months is the maximum). ... When your mail forwarding period ends, USPS will return your mail to the sender for 6 months with a label that has your new address.

source_extracts.claim: Forwarding duration by mail class: First-Class/Ground Advantage/Priority 12 months; Periodicals 60 days; Marketing Mail and Parcel Select only if mailer specifies, may be postage due; mail starts arriving at new address within 7-10 postal business days; months 13-18 returned to sender with new address attached
source_extracts.quote: |First-Class Mail / USPS Ground Advantage / Priority Mail service (bills, invoices, personal correspondence, reply mail)|12 months| ... |Periodicals (magazines, newsletters)|60 days| ... |USPS Marketing Mail (advertisements, catalogs, retail offers)|Only forwarded IF the mailer specifies forwarding instructions May be subject to postage due| ... Mail starts arriving to your new address within 7-10 Postal business days of the COA start date. ... During this 7-10 day period, your mail is inaccessible.

source_extracts.claim: Online COA costs $1.25 identity-verification fee; PFS-Residential is a single weekly shipment of all mail via Priority Mail for a fee, extendable up to a year
source_extracts.quote: Free - $1.25 identify verification for online COA requests. ... PFS-Residential Service provides a single weekly shipment of all mail for a residence via Priority Mail service for a fee. The service can be extended for up to a year.

source_extracts.claim: Temporary COA: minimum 15 days, maximum 364 days, extendable once for up to 179 additional days, total cannot exceed 12 months
source_extracts.quote: The minimum time period for temporary forwarding is 15 days. Temporary COAs, or seasonal forwarding, provide forwarding of mail to a temporary address for a maximum of 364 days... A new request can be filed extending the temporary COA for up to an additional 179 days... The total forwarding time on a temporary move cannot exceed 12 months.
